metricText: BLS QCEW annual average of monthly employment for NAICS 624410 Child care services in U.S. private establishments.
note: PROPOSED FOR DIRECT BLS QCEW, NOT ALFRED: BLS directly prints the U.S. private-ownership annual average, but the exact ENU series has no FRED/ALFRED mirror. This national private-employment series is narrower than the bill report's fixed rural-county, all-covered-employment panel and must not be described as rural employment, all ownerships, child-care slots, affordability, or bill-attributable employment.

verification.reason: Fresh FRED searches found six NAICS 624410 series, all from BLS Industry Productivity, and zero results when either 624410 or the exact child-day-care wording was filtered to FRED's QCEW tag. The BLS-derived private QCEW series ID ENUUS000105624410 returns 36 monthly rows from the official BLS timeseries API for 2023-2025, while both its FRED CSV URL and ALFRED series URL return 404. The official BLS annual industry slices separately print private annual_avg_emplvl values of 954,796 for 2023, 983,412 for 2024, and 991,735 for 2025. The concept is therefore source-valid but cannot use the alfred-fred family; Wave B must extend the existing direct BLS QCEW family to annual slices and first-print custody.

closestNonMatchEvidence.title: Employment for Health Care and Social Assistance: Child Day Care Services (NAICS 624410) in the United States
closestNonMatchEvidence.scopeVerbatim: Employment is the total number of wage and salary workers, unincorporated self-employed workers, and unpaid family workers working within business establishments. An individual who works multiple jobs at separate establishments would have each job included in the number of employees.
closestNonMatchEvidence.mismatch: This is BLS Industry Productivity employment, not QCEW UI-covered private employment. It explicitly includes unincorporated self-employed and unpaid family workers, and its 2025 value of 1,361.5 thousand jobs does not equal the direct QCEW private annual_avg_emplvl of 991,735.
